messages:
Anya (Design): Quick design q — when users bump a canary from 0% -> 10% we currently show a toast 'Canary started'. Feels vague. Thinking we need a 'speedbump' confirmation modal to reduce accidental traffic changes. Thoughts?

Kevin (PM): +1, saw a support ticket where someone mis-clicked and hit 100% by mistake. Modal should explain impact and give clear undo window.

Maria (Frontend): Agree. UX: small modal, inline diff of traffic allocation, and keyboard-first. Need exact copy for buttons.

Jared (A11y): Important: modal must trap focus, announce with `role='alertdialog'` and `aria-describedby`. Also provide a clear accessible short message for screenreader users (<=120 chars).

Anya (Design): Draft copy options:
1) 'Confirm canary: Shift X traffic to v2 for gradual validation. You can undo for 3 minutes.'
2) 'Start canary (10%): Route a fraction of users to v2. Monitor performance; undo within 3m.'
Which is clearer?

Kevin (PM): Leaning to option 2 but shorten 'monitor performance' -> 'check metrics'.

Maria (Frontend): For keyboard: primary should be 'Start canary' (Enter) secondary 'Cancel' (Esc). Also we need microcopy under primary: 'Undo available for 3 minutes' — small gray.

Jared (A11y): Proposed SR copy: "Canary started for version 2 at 10 percent. Undo available for three minutes." Use `aria-live='assertive'` when canary actually starts.

Anya (Design): Nice. Also debating animation: small 'speedbump' pulse to draw attention to timeline lane where allocation changed — not full-screen. Thoughts on motion?

Maria (Frontend): Keep it subtle, reduce motion preference respected: `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` -> no pulse. CSS snippet:
```
@keyframes pulse { from {opacity:1} to {opacity:.6} }
.canary-pulse { animation: pulse 800ms ease-in-out 2; }
```

Kevin (PM): Ops wants an extra confirmation if change >25% or to 100% — maybe different modal copy for 'big changes'.

Anya (Design): Good call. Variant copy for large changes: 'This will reroute X of traffic to v2. For big changes we recommend a canary ramp or scheduling during off-peak.' Add an explicit checkbox 'I understand this change' for >25%.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: v2 -> 10% started (job id: 8241).

Maria (Frontend): Will implement modal, aria attributes, and pulse class. I'll post PR with copy variants.

Anya (Design): Sweet. @Jared can you confirm SR copy is concise enough? @Kevin will you own the support doc update?

Jared (A11y): Yep, SR copy ok. One ask: include a brief note in the modal about 'how to undo' with keyboard shortcut info.

Kevin (PM): I'll update support doc and add an FAQ blurb. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
